purpose: R4CA CLI/noninteractive/ACP mutation evidence. Every row deletes one load-bearing refusal and must turn its named exact witness red. R4CA03 is the required visible-output-plus-retry compound mutant; R4CA04 is the required cancel-plus-terminal compound mutant. R4CA33 restores connection-before-complete-ACP-admission at the single shared ingress owner.
isolation: Every mutant is applied once in a disposable detached worktree at the immutable candidate SHA.

A duplicate durable sequence with different canonical bytes is refused.
The stdout record count bound fires before another record is written.
Duplicate value options are refused instead of last-value-wins.
Unknown ACP fields are refused rather than ignored.
Every advisory live event triggers reconciliation from durable truth.
An oversized SSE frame is refused before decode.
Provider-shaped and unknown event kinds cannot enter the CLI event closure.
Explicit null does not collapse into an absent SSE durable reference.
